name: TRINX 千里达 GTR C6
why_interesting: The retained matte-black/green card matches the China-market carbon GTR C6 and its LTWOO 1x12 exact-model configuration. Complete weight, maximum clearance and meaningful stiffness evidence remain unpublished.

facts.drivetrain: LTWOO / 蓝图 GR7010 mechanical 1x12 with 42T crank and 11-46T cassette
facts.frame: China-market GTR C6 carbon frame with carbon 700C fork
facts.frame_material: Carbon frame and carbon fork for the China-market GTR C6; exact fiber grade, lay-up and molding process are not published
facts.tires: CST 700x40C on the documented exact-model 1x12 build; fitted width is not treated as maximum clearance
facts.brakes: LTWOO hydraulic disc brakes on the documented exact-model 1x12 build

missing: Exact complete-bike weight and weighing basis
Exact production-batch wheels, cockpit, included accessories and substitutions
Current checkout conditions and domestic warranty route
source_note: The current China listing establishes carbon construction and 12-speed identity; the official regional catalog supplies the matching green/brown LTWOO GR7010 1x12 build. Aluminum regional GTR C6 variants and an internally inconsistent 11-speed index token are not transferred.
